claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal Ruueben O. Beck is confirmed as the Army entrant recorded as Rueben O. Beck in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private service identifier and compatible enlisted status establish the match despite the one-letter spelling difference; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier, matching surname and middle initial, near-exact given name, and compatible enlisted Army status.
claims.temporal_assessment: The official record dates Army entry to March 19, 1945; later OSS chronology is not established.
claims.match_notes: Both spellings remain visible. The decisive private identifier is never exposed in public data.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in March 1945, Rueben O. Beck's civilian occupation was construction-machinery operation.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-matched Army row carries code 524; NARA's alphabetical code list defines that group and names no employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private-identifier match confirms the Army-entry row belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on March 19, 1945, but not proven to be his final civilian role before OSS.
claims.match_notes: No employer, workplace, or self-employment status is inferred.
